BiblicalUsage: Rabbith is a place in Palestine, a town in the inheritance of Issachar. Joshua lists it with Kishion and Ebez and Remeth and En-gannim among the cities of Issachar's lot.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the town lists matter: every place had its name written down, because every family had its inheritance from God.
